metadata.scope: Architecture claims in docs and README, checked against backend, frontend, Prisma, Docker, and CI sources.
metadata.trust: medium for high-level topology; low for counts, matching behaviour, traceability, and deployment

edges.description: User opens the web application.
REST API calls plus an SSE subscription for live updates.
Prisma CRUD against the SQLite datasource.
Supported PostgreSQL schema, selected by the database switch script. Production usage is unresolved.
Adapters fetch JSON, RSS, HTML, and Telegram channel pages.
Persists jobs and source runs through Prisma.
Collection invokes incremental matching after a run.
Persists JobMatch rows and match-cycle records.
Qualifying matches are handed to the notification router.
Telegram-first delivery when the user has a reachable link.
Creates Notification rows, including the web-inbox fallback.
Emits match events to the user's SSE stream.
Long-polls getUpdates and sends messages.
Scheduled FAST/DEEP collection.
Ten-minute match cycle and ghost detection.
Daily digest generation.
Stores uploaded CV files on local disk.
Persists application stages and transition history.
Typecheck, tests, and dependency audit.
TypeScript check and production build.

claims.claim: Next.js frontend on 3211, NestJS backend on 3210, Prisma over SQLite/PostgreSQL.
16 Prisma models.
claims.observed: 22 models; six are absent from the document and 'Source' should be 'JobSource'.

claims.claim: 15 source adapters with the listed adapter names.
claims.observed: 11 web sources + 3 Telegram channels = 14 endpoints; 12 adapter classes; seven listed adapters do not exist.

claims.claim: Cross-source fingerprint deduplication prevents duplicates from different sources.
claims.observed: Fingerprint is stored only; dedupeWithinRun groups sourceJobId within one run; no fingerprint query exists.

claims.claim: Jobs without extractable skills receive 0.65 skill credit.
Matching uses penalties but no hard eligibility result.
claims.observed: Hard-ineligible jobs get score 0 and eligible=false; MatchResult exposes eligible and ineligibleReasons.

claims.claim: ProfileInput has skills, targetRoles, locationTiers, remote, employmentTypes, years, minSalary, excludeOnsite.
Incremental matching runs every 30 minutes.
claims.observed: MATCH_CYCLE_INTERVAL defaults to 10 minutes; collection is 30 minutes.

claims.claim: Role similarity uses exact substring matching; seniority also fires via synonym match.
claims.observed: Token-aware phrase matching; seniority uses only the title regex and a <4-year check.

claims.claim: ~227 tests across the indexed files; per-file counts as listed.
claims.observed: 23 spec files, 252 it/test declarations; many per-file counts differ; four spec files are absent from the index.

claims.claim: Each of the 11 adapters parses fixtures in adapters.spec.ts.
claims.observed: Ten web adapters are parser-tested; HagereJobs is only mocked in the service test.

claims.claim: Sources failing 3+ consecutive cycles are auto-disabled.
claims.observed: Auto-disable requires a full 10-run window with zero successes; HEALTH_AUTO_DISABLE_THRESHOLD=50 is unused.

claims.claim: PostgreSQL is the production database and Prisma migrations are the deployment path.
claims.observed: Docker production path uses a SQLite file and prisma db push --accept-data-loss; the runbook uses PostgreSQL and prisma migrate deploy.

claims.claim: Category-aware collection is a plan, not yet implemented.
claims.observed: The mapper, taxonomy, SourceRunCategory model, and FAST/DEEP collection modes exist.

claims.claim: The module map is complete.
claims.observed: matches is omitted; health is a controller-only module and integration is a test-only directory.

claims.claim: 20+ frontend routes; 17+ feature routes.
claims.observed: 19 page routes; the overview lists 16 feature routes and omits /, /error, /forbidden.

claims.claim: Updated August 2026.
claims.observed: Docs last changed 2026-08-28; code last changed 2026-10-22.

claims.claim: Architecture diagrams are maintained sources.
claims.observed: Only ASCII diagrams inside Markdown; no .dot/.dsl/.mmd/.puml source.

claims.claim: JWT_SECRET is required.
claims.observed: The service auto-generates a random secret when missing; persistent sessions require the env var.

claims.claim: Key design decisions are recorded.
claims.observed: Five prose decisions; no ADR files or decision records with source links.

unknowns.question: Which production database and migration path is authoritative?
unknowns.whyItMatters: The README, runbook, and Docker path disagree; backup and migration procedures differ.
unknowns.nextCheck: Confirm the actual deployment target and run a restore drill against it.
unknowns.status: resolved 2026-10-27: SQLite authoritative, db-migrate-safe.js the only migration path

unknowns.question: Do the services start and serve the documented ports and health endpoint?
unknowns.whyItMatters: No runtime evidence was collected; both local ports refused connections.
unknowns.nextCheck: Start the stack and run a smoke test against /api/health and the frontend routes.
unknowns.status: resolved 2026-10-30: live stack verified in Chromium by frontend/e2e/runtime-verification.spec.ts

unknowns.question: What is the executed test count and pass/fail status?
unknowns.whyItMatters: The traceability matrix and README disagree with the static declaration count.
unknowns.nextCheck: Run the backend test suite in CI and publish the jest summary next to the matrix.
unknowns.status: resolved 2026-10-30: 377 tests pass across 28 spec files (325 declarations)

unknowns.question: Are 41/53 requirements actually covered?
unknowns.whyItMatters: The per-file counts and file index are stale, so the 77% figure is not reproducible.
unknowns.nextCheck: Regenerate requirement-to-test mappings from test names and requirement IDs.
unknowns.status: resolved 2026-10-30: docs/traceability.md is now generated from JobHunter_SRS_v2.3.md and the spec tree (85 requirements, 76 tested, 4 deferred = 94%, 0 unexplained gaps); the hand-typed 41/53 figure is gone and two CI checks (traceability.matrix, traceability.proseCoverage) fail on drift

unknowns.question: Should cross-source fingerprint deduplication be implemented or removed from the architecture?
unknowns.whyItMatters: It is a product/data-integrity decision, not only a documentation fix.
unknowns.nextCheck: Decide with the product owner; add a test either way.
unknowns.status: resolved 2026-10-27: same-source fingerprint guard implemented and tested; cross-source grouping intentionally unimplemented (no measured group spans sources)

unknowns.question: Is HagereJobs parser output verified against a fixture?
unknowns.whyItMatters: The adapter exists but no parser-level test was found.
unknowns.nextCheck: Add a fixture parser test or document the coverage gap.
unknowns.status: resolved 2026-10-30: 4 fixture tests in adapters.spec.ts cover both card layouts, sparse cards, and the empty-listing failure; they exposed and fixed a card-scoping defect in hagerejobs.adapter.ts
